description: Peptide-level evidence for the two fragments versus the paralog, and branch separation of Nit1-like and Nit2-like yeast CN-hydrolases
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
s = requests.Session(); s.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
out="/agent/jobs/6da7974d-8050-41f7-bb23-602b12e418f7/provenance"

# re-run the peptide query and store counts
pep={}
for acc in ["P40447","P40446","P47016"]:
    r=s.get(f"https://www.ebi.ac.uk/proteins/api/proteomics/{acc}",headers={"Accept":"application/json"},timeout=90)
    pep[acc]= len(r.json().get("features",[])) if r.status_code==200 else 0
print("peptide features:", pep)
pd.DataFrame([dict(accession=k, gene={'P40447':'NIT1/YIL164C','P40446':'YIL165C','P47016':'NIT2/YJL126W'}[k],
                   peptide_features=v, http_status=('200' if v else '404 no records')) for k,v in pep.items()]
            ).to_csv(f"{out}/peptide_evidence.csv", index=False)

br=pd.read_csv(f"{out}/cn_hydrolase_branch_classification.csv")

fig,(ax1,ax2)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1,1.5]})

labels=['NIT1 / YIL164C\n(P40447, 199 aa)','YIL165C\n(P40446, 119 aa)','NIT2 / YJL126W\n(P47016, 307 aa)']
vals=[pep['P40447'],pep['P40446'],pep['P47016']]
ax1.bar(labels, vals, color=['#4C78A8','#72B7B2','#59A14F'])
for i,v in enumerate(vals):
    ax1.text(i, v+0.4, str(v) if v else '0 (no records)', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('peptide features in the EBI Proteins API\nproteomics endpoint')
ax1.set_ylim(0,25)
ax1.set_title('A. Mass-spectrometry peptide evidence', loc='left', fontsize=11)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8)
for sp in ['top','right']: ax1.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

c={'Nit1-like':'#4C78A8','Nit2-like':'#59A14F'}
for b,gdf in br.groupby('branch'):
    ax2.scatter(gdf.pid_vs_ScNit2, gdf.pid_vs_ScNit1, s=38, color=c[b], label=b, alpha=0.85, edgecolor='white', lw=0.6)
ax2.plot([0,100],[0,100], color='#999999', lw=0.8, ls='--')
for _,r in br.iterrows():
    if r.pid_vs_ScNit1>70 or r.pid_vs_ScNit2>75:
        ax2.annotate(r.acc, (r.pid_vs_ScNit2, r.pid_vs_ScNit1), fontsize=7, xytext=(3,3), textcoords='offset points')
ax2.annotate('Lachancea thermotolerans C5DH06\n323 aa, single ORF', (25.8,73.2), fontsize=8,
             xytext=(34,74), textcoords='data', arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=0.7, color='#555555'))
ax2.set_xlabel('% identity to S. cerevisiae Nit2 (P47016)')
ax2.set_ylabel('% identity to reconstructed\nfull-length S. cerevisiae Nit1 (322 aa)')
ax2.set_title('B. Nit1 and Nit2 are distinct branches across 25 yeast CN-hydrolase proteins', loc='left', fontsize=11)
ax2.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9, loc='upper center')
ax2.set_xlim(15,95); ax2.set_ylim(15,100)
for sp in ['top','right']: ax2.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
